translations.web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
translations.bsb: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king; his mouth must not betray justice.
translations.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
translations.asv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.
